metadata.name: plan-decision-drawer
metadata.description: Performance capture for the ranked decision drawer. Opens /plan with the decision drawer routed open, waits for the ranked next-action list, and records how many entries rendered.

metadata.label: Open the Plan board with the decision drawer routed open
Wait for the ranked next-action list

evaluate.expression: (() => { const list = document.querySelector('[data-testid="ranked-next-action-feed"]'); const entries = list ? list.querySelectorAll('article').length : 0; performance.mark('bas.plan-decision-drawer.ready'); window.localStorage.setItem('swarm-manager.perf.plan-decision-drawer.size', JSON.stringify({ entries })); return { entries }; })()

metadata.label: Record rendered ranked-entry count for trace notes
